title: Cabin environment alert
summary: Operational air or pressure alert, or several crew members with simultaneous symptoms in a consistent context. The alarm type is kept: pressure, smoke, CO₂ or other. With evidence of a source, environmental exposure must be ruled out. A normal SpO₂ never replaces the ship procedure: conventional oximetry does not detect carbon monoxide. An alarm reported by text is treated as reported, not as confirmed. Informational support only: not a diagnosis or a treatment decision. No clinical personnel on board: the steps are first aid and monitoring; treatment depends on mission procedures.

confirmed_event.text: Cabin alarm CONFIRMED by the ship: follow the ship procedure now. A normal SpO₂ does not rule it out.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Follow the ship procedure for this alarm and check the alarm panel.
Confirm with the ship's environmental measurement.
Do not use SpO₂ to rule out the problem: a conventional oximeter does not measure CO₂ or detect carbon monoxide.
